'''Ulaire Roye''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he was stationed in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], near the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]]. He was accompanied by a friend of his named [[Larek Tatham]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ulaire Roye was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
